about: 38 R1 behaviour lock: the suites every roadmap-38 (UI redesign) PR keeps green. `npm run e2e:lock` runs them all; `npm run e2e -- @lock` is the same. The lock-* suites compare against fixtures/lock/*.json, recorded on the pre-redesign UI (v1.24.0) with LOCK_RECORD=1 — a redesign PR never re-records them (SPEC §0: a change that needs to alter behaviour is split out). See tests/e2e/README.md › Behaviour lock.

excluded.dock-chrome: red on v1.24.0 run alone (70/1): 9.3 measures a Node editor tab's pixel width (103.55 vs ~98) — a LAYOUT number the redesign changes, not behaviour; its 70 behaviour checks pass
excluded.dock-inset: red on v1.24.0 run alone: a locator.click times out after 27 passes (2026-10-06, twice)
excluded.panels: red on v1.24.0 run alone: 'properties header shows the type chip' + a click timeout; panel open/close breadth is lock-panels
excluded.panel-shortcuts: red on v1.24.0 run alone: 3b.1 premise says no optional view is on the toolbar of a fresh profile, but Animation is on the default bar since roadmap 33; the keys themselves are locked by lock-shortcuts
excluded.themes: red on v1.24.0: 11/1 in the battery, then a setup timeout alone; custom-theme restyling is covered by theme-import + theme-tokens and the custom-theme baselines
